g.text: Read the cotangent from this triangle
More residual spread needs a larger mean departure
The threshold for the statistic stays fixed; the required unstandardized mean departure grows.
A: t = 7.71 (reject). B: t = 3.03 (do not reject). Scaling both legs equally leaves t unchanged.
